stories.title: Americans vote in battle for Senate and House control— live updates
stories.titleEn: Americans vote in battle for Senate and House control— live updates
stories.summary: Control of Congress and the fate of President Trump's legislative agenda are now in the hands of American voters, who are heading to the polls to decide the 2026 midterm elections. Though President Trump’s name is not on the ballot, voters are weighing the effects of his agenda in Tuesday’s midterm elections. The first polling sites have opened in a handful of states — Connecticut, Indiana, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Missouri, New Jersey, New York and Virginia
